team.name: Agent
team.description:
Run a sub-agent on one task and return its final answer.
Without a name it is a one-off sub-agent: it runs synchronously, answers, then is reclaimed.
With a name it becomes a persistent teammate that keeps a mailbox, so assign it work with SendMessage.
subagent_type picks its AgentDefinition; general-purpose is the default.
Available subagent types:
- general-purpose: General-purpose agent that inherits the run tools for routine tasks

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform.

subagent_type.description: Type of specialized agent to use, from the available subagent types. Defaults to "general-purpose".

name.description: Name for a persistent teammate that keeps a mailbox; omit it for a one-off sub-agent.

model.description: Optional model override: "provider/model", a bare name in the session provider, or "inherit".

run_in_background.description: Run this one-off sub-agent in the background; its answer arrives in your inbox when it finishes.

team.name: SendMessage
team.description:
Send a message to a teammate by name, or "*" to broadcast to every other teammate.
The message lands in their mailbox and is injected on their next idle turn, so do not re-send it or poll them:
their answer arrives as a teammate-message.

to.description: Teammate name, or "*" for every other teammate.

message.description: Plain text, delivered to the recipient as written.

team.name: TaskOutput
team.description:
Read what a background task has produced: a background shell command's output, or a sub-agent's answer.
Waits for the task by default, so a timeout report means it is still running rather than that it failed.

task_id.description: The ID of the background task or sub-agent to read.

block.description: Wait for the task to finish before returning.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait when block is true (max 600000).

team.name: TaskStop
team.description: Permanently stop a background task or one of your own sub-agents, by its task id.

task_id.description: The ID of the task or sub-agent to stop.

team.name: TeamCreate
team.description:
Gather the work under one named team. The team and its task list are the same thing:
every task you create from now on belongs to it, and so does every teammate you spawn.
Call it once, before the work is divided.

team_name.description: Name of the team to gather the work under.

description.description: What the team is working on.

team.name: TeamDelete
team.description:
Throw away the current team and its task list once the work is done.
It refuses while a teammate is still running, so stop them first with TaskStop.

team.name: TaskCreate
team.description:
Create a new task in the shared task list, so the work is tracked and claimable.
Use it for anything with more than one step, and check TaskList first so work is not duplicated.
New tasks are created with status "pending" and no owner: use TaskUpdate with owner to assign one.

subject.description: A brief, actionable title in imperative form, e.g. "Fix login bug".

description.description: What needs to be done, in enough detail for another agent to finish it.

activeForm.description: Present continuous form shown while the task is in_progress, e.g. "Running tests".

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata to attach to the task; any keys are kept.

team.name: TaskList
team.description: List every task in the shared list with its status, owner and open blockers, so work is not duplicated.

team.name: TaskGet
team.description: Read one task in full, including its description and the dependencies in both directions.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to retrieve.

team.name: TaskUpdate
team.description:
Change a task: move it through pending, in_progress and completed, hand it to an owner,
or link it with addBlocks / addBlockedBy. status "deleted" removes it.
Mark a task in_progress before starting it, and completed only when the work is fully done.

taskId.description: The ID of the task to update.

activeForm.description: Present continuous form shown while it is in_progress, e.g. "Running tests".

owner.description: Agent name to assign the task to.

metadata.description: Metadata keys to merge into the task; set a key to null to delete it.

addBlocks.description: Task IDs that cannot start until this one completes.

addBlockedBy.description: Task IDs that must complete before this one can start.
